The following detailed bindings refine the existing D-076 EU privacy baseline;
no earlier feature PASS covers these additions. The controlling contracts own the
workflow details rather than this feature creating a second policy.

| ID | Requirement | Priority | Verification |
|---|---|---|---|
| FSC-15 | Follow [rights intake and verified response](../../docs/phase-1-architecture/contracts/SECURITY_PRIVACY_CONTRACT.md#rights-intake-and-verified-response-proposal--2026-10-09): preserve original receipt, proportionate verification and explicit case/object authority; apply the assessed mixed-data response, applicable calendar-month deadline and secure recipient-bound delivery; rights response is distinct from completed scoped deletion | Must | Authorized synthetic rights handling plus actual protected read/delivery/deletion/copy boundaries; no default ID upload, visitor account or automatic destructive action |
| FSC-16 | Follow [incident assessment/escalation/recovery](../../docs/phase-1-architecture/contracts/SECURITY_PRIVACY_CONTRACT.md#incident-assessment-escalation-and-recovery--v1): distinguish alert/awareness/interruption; assess privacy impact, actual processing role and competent recipients; preserve applicable notification/communication duties, minimal case evidence and separate recovery/delivery outcomes | Must | [Defined synthetic rehearsal scenarios](../../docs/phase-1-architecture/contracts/QA_RECOVERY.md#incident-response-rehearsal--v1) after separate execution approval; actual boundary/clock/authority and qualified channel evidence, not a tabletop-only runtime claim |

## Non-Functional Requirements

| Rights-case and incident evidence | Restricted personal/security material as mapped | Explicit case-specific privacy/security purpose and actual grants; contact alone grants no data access | Approved purpose/copy policy and finite necessity reviews; no blanket 90-day or unlimited investigation archive | Separate protected handling and safe audit references; no transcript/credential payload in general diagnostics | No unverified mailbox, transfer, authority or notification route |
| Diagnostic/aggregate evidence |

edits.old: These are future behavior oracles from requirements, not executed tests.
edits.new:
20. **Given** a recognized rights request through privacy or another provided official channel, **when** authorized handling verifies and scopes it, **then** original receipt and the applicable calendar-month deadline remain, case-specific control and recipient authorization precede disclosure, and replying does not imply completed deletion. Names/emails, mailbox access, old process proofs or absence of visitor accounts cannot replace the controlling verification/limitation rules.
21. **Given** a scoped access request involving mixed personal data or another person's interests, **when** the handler prepares a response, **then** concrete impact and balancing determine proportionate measures and useful remaining access; no blanket exclusion, whole database dump or disclosure of unrelated credentials. Exact approved privacy operations and copy/deletion policies still apply.
22. **Given** evolving incident facts, affected people and uncertain notification/recovery outcomes, **when** scoped handlers assess and respond, **then** the controlling incident workflow preserves supported awareness, actual controller/processor duties, all competent recipients and distinct authority/individual decisions; incomplete counts, weekends, owner changes or an RTO result cannot silently extend/reset legal clocks or certify delivery. The incorporated rehearsal catalogue supplies the detailed cases, including breach-nature description for individual notices and assessed exception conditions; no actual communication is authorized by this feature.

These are future behavior oracles from requirements, not executed tests.
